execution.ref: .agent/decisions/2026-10-05-GRAPHITE-ORACLE-AGREED-ADMISSIBLE-01.md (re-judge of phase-4 Attacker session 1 on a read-only copy)
execution.description: Added the AGREED_ADMISSIBLE oracle outcome so an advisory tool and Carbon's authoritative chain agreeing on a valid, in-contract design can close, and re-judged session 1.

expected: Once the oracle stopped reading advisory acceptance as a breach, a valid design that check_design and the authoritative chain both accept would close.
observed: The family's detector does not fire on a valid design, so the oracle read the agreement INCONCLUSIVE and verify recorded UNDETERMINED (oracle_inconclusive); session 1 attempts 007-01 and 014-01 could never close. With the new outcome only those two changed on re-judge (UNDETERMINED to AGREED_ADMISSIBLE); zero findings before and after.
keep: Give a clean agreement its own explicit, versioned outcome rather than folding it into HELD or leaving it UNDETERMINED: an agreement is not evidence that a defense held.

Guard the outcome on Carbon's own full authoritative chain AND the level contract, on the same rebuilt construction, and never let it apply beside a breach, a usability record, a canary or isolation hit, or an authoritative refusal.
Bump the verdict and report schema versions when the outcome vocabulary grows, and read each record under its own version so earlier re-judge reports keep their meaning.
change: Each guard of a new oracle outcome needs its own mutation test against a stub adapter, because the real adapter's oracle already refuses most failing cases and would mask a missing guard.
